question: What will happen when you select the cell contents of a particular row in MS-Excel and then click the Delete button?

options.text: Entries in all the selected cells will be deleted
First five cell entries will be deleted
Only first three cells will be deleted

solution:
The correct answer is __**Entries in all the selected cells will be deleted**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When you select the cell contents of a particular row in MS-Excel and then click the **Delete** button, **entries in all the selected cells will be deleted**.
 
• This action will clear the content of the cells but will not delete the entire row.
 
• To delete the entire row
